page_title: ALA 0-2 RAY | Alaves v Rayo Vallecano 29/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+2' Rayo Vallecano work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+2' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Manu Sanchez will be replaced by Asier Villalibre (Alaves).
89' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
87' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Unai Lopez leaves the pitch and Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
85' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
82' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.
80' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Munuera had an easy-decision to make.
78' We are about to witness a subsitution. Tomas Conechny (Alaves) for Joan Jordan.
78' Aridane Hernandez (Rayo Vallecano) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
77' Santiago Mourino (Alaves) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
77' Toni Martinez (Alaves) wins the ball from the corner and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but it's a soft effort and drifts well past the left post.
77' Joan Jordan (Alaves) prepares to take a corner kick.
75' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Alaves comes to nothing.

73' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant.
73' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
70' Substitution. Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) in, Jorge de Frutos out.
70' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Alvaro Garcia is replaced by Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano).
67' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
62' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) receives a yellow card.
62' Santiago Mourino (Alaves) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
59' Eduardo Coudet has decided to substitute Carles Alena and he is replaced by Carlos Martin (Alaves).
59' Today's match ends for Jon Guridi who will be replaced by Toni Martinez (Alaves).
58' 0 - 2 Wonderful finish from Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano). He drills a low shot precisely into the bottom left corner. No chance for the goalkeeper.
54' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Randy Nteka will be replaced by Pacha (Rayo Vallecano).
54' The referee signals a substitution. Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) is brought on as a substitute for Oscar Trejo.
52' Alaves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

52' Augusto Batalla pulls off a fantastic save! Jon Guridi (Alaves) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out. Alaves force a corner. They send men into the box.
47' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) makes a rough challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Half-time substitution. Eduardo Coudet decided to make a change. Pau Cabanes is replaced by Carlos Vicente (Alaves).
46' The whistle blows and Jose Munuera starts the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle as Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) was too aggressive in his challenge.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post.
42' Having seen unsporting behavior, Jose Munuera shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) is the recipient.
39' Joan Jordan (Alaves) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Pelayo Fernandez (Rayo Vallecano) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
36' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
34' Pau Cabanes (Alaves) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
31' Rayo Vallecano seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
30' Jose Munuera couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Pau Cabanes (Alaves) and blew his whistle.
26' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Munuera saw the whole situation.
25' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jose Munuera blows for a foul.
25' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
24' Joan Jordan (Alaves) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
21' Jose Munuera blows for a foul after Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
16' Pau Cabanes (Alaves) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
16' Joan Jordan (Alaves) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

16' Joan Jordan (Alaves) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. The ball is out of play. Alaves will have a chance to score from a corner.
13' Joan Jordan (Alaves) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
12' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY to Alaves! Great chance to score.
12' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) is adjudged offside.
11' Jon Guridi (Alaves) is able to continue to play.
10' The game is interrupted now, Jon Guridi (Alaves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
9' The free kick from long range, taken by Alaves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
8' Pelayo Fernandez (Rayo Vallecano) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
6' Alaves force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

2' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header into the top of the net. 0:1.
2' There's an opportunity for Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Alaves will have the kick-off.
Jose Munuera will officiate today.
